name: Prague
limitations: Conditional research judgments, not measurements or ranking. Institution/operator/municipal areas and user/patient cohorts differ from the full FUA. Resident eligibility, affordability, current continuity and pre-cutoff availability assumptions remain reversible. Unknowns do not penalise capability or transparency. Full conditional62 requires all eight named assumptions;29partial/1context/1unresolved subpillars are not full measurements. Rejecting new PCS/GSS/RES/MED assumptions together restores29-84 without centre.

dimensions.rationale: Actual flood-protection deployment, delivered local adaptation projects and usable cooling guidance support scoped protection, retaining heat/flood/wet-soil tree hazards, unfinished projects and unresolved geological vulnerability.
dimensions.assumption: Accept coverage of the principal hazards and usual residents, normally effective protection and continuation; unreviewed geophysical/other hazards must not dominate residual unmitigated vulnerability. Reject to unknown; important protection failures40, stronger multi-hazard protection80.

dimensions.rationale: Local sabotage/threat investigations and responses, BIS2025 observations and cooperation support bounded current-impact interpretation. Low national terrorism threat is not a city rate; Russian sabotage, regional war, diplomatic and transport-node exposure remain.
dimensions.assumption: Accept national mechanisms and specific local nodes as representative of usual535 residents and cutoff conditions, with normally limited realized disruption. Reject to unknown; important current living/channel restrictions40, stronger low-impact and response evidence80.

dimensions.rationale: Actual July2025 emergency-site backup activation and fuel replenishment, completed electric restoration, digital submissions and scoped service feedback demonstrate functioning delivery and adaptation. Transport/hot-water disruption and uneven district integration remain; mixed customer satisfaction is not social cohesion or a whole-resident outcome.
dimensions.assumption: Accept these actual institutional/service outcomes as relevant to generally functioning institutions for ordinary FUA residents, continuing to cutoff with meaningful group/scope gaps. Broader social cohesion remains an inference, not a measurement. Reject necessary scope/time/resident/representativeness assumptions to restore unknown.

dimensions.rationale: Actual water delivery and outage alternatives, food distribution/help, energy restoration and administrative-Prague household affordability evidence support ordinary provision. Shared-grid disruption, parameters not residents, food/heating deprivation and eligibility limits remain.
dimensions.assumption: Accept operator/municipal scope and household observations as limited representatives, usual affordable access and effective relevant help/alternatives continuing to cutoff. Reject to unknown; important residual basic-resource constraints40, stronger multi-source/common-cause resilience80.

dimensions.rationale: Delivered broad routine/necessary specialist care, public-insurance paths, urgency prioritization, operational expansion and actual safety management jointly support usual appropriate care. Long waits and cognitive-clinic restrictions remain; audit/report counts are not measured clinical effectiveness.
dimensions.assumption: Accept usual quality inferred from operating professional care and safety processes, normally eligible affordable access, limited timely alternatives and scope/continuation. No additional perfect current risk-adjusted outcomes or all-hospital stress-test requirement. Reject to unknown; important necessary-care bottlenecks remaining after alternatives40, stronger quality and continuity80.

dimensions.rationale: Actual2025 local CAR-T administration, credible human/regulatory evidence, a reviewed Czech approved inpatient reimbursement route with individual approval and local specialist monitoring support limited translation.21 versus23 patient counts and44 distributed products are distinct unresolved counts, not a deduplicated cohort or44 treated residents.
dimensions.assumption: Accept disease-path representativeness and locally relevant approved treatment continuing at cutoff, appropriate current safety/follow-up, and eligible ordinary insured median-income residents normally able to enter and afford care. National payment rules do not prove individual payment or local patient residence. Reject necessary scope/time/safety/eligibility/cost assumptions to restore unknown; verified material access gaps could support40, distinct mature broadly accessible pathways80.

dimensions.rationale: Charles2025 actual patents/licenses, CTU FIT publications and deployed industrial/security products provide multiple productive nodes; OICT2025 broad transport-app use, actual municipal digital submissions and completed2026 sensor-to-routine-service delivery connect knowledge to use. University-wide outputs and app users are not all local products or unique FUA residents; pilots/planned services are not completed general integration.
dimensions.assumption: Accept the multi-node capability and substantial ordinary-resident diffusion are locally relevant and sustained to cutoff, without deriving a resident rate from user counts or assigning all university/network outputs to535.80 follows the same high-capability anchor as Singapore: no single production node controls all critical knowledge/industry/diffusion, not perfect equality or independent testing of every product. If documented integration/skills/cost barriers remain material after mitigation60 is an alternative; missing data or lower licensing income alone cannot cap at60. Reject necessary scope/time/user/resident assumptions to restore unknown.

dimensions.rationale: Actual airport routes/traffic and used transport channels, a Czech-citizen conditional EU mobility route and actual bank cross-border service support ordinary options. The2025 blackout interrupted metro/trams; bank deadlines, account/AML/cost conditions and shared dependence remain. Multiple modes are not independent power/communication fallbacks.
dimensions.assumption: Accept ordinary citizens can normally qualify for and afford reviewed transport/accounts/communications and pathways continue at cutoff across the FUA. German residence rights retain employment/search/resources/insurance conditions. Undated bank guidance requires cutoff availability assumption. Reject necessary eligibility/cost/time/scope assumptions to restore unknown.
